summary: A change interrupted mid-security-review resumed correctly on all four arms, and the reviewed constraint it retrieved from the publisher held.
no_security_review_because: the change consumed an already-reviewed pin, and the reviewing policy does not re-review a consumed version

prior_learning.why: the publisher recorded a deployment constraint that this consumer's own deployment had to respect

instances.subject: deployment constraint recorded by the publishing team

refusal_or_degradation.what_happened: the session was interrupted between review and its conclusion; the reconnect returned the latest authorized checkpoint, the last receipt, unresolved feedback on that receipt, and reviewed learning newer than it
refusal_or_degradation.detected_by: the participant, who resumed and continued without reconstructing anything by hand
